+title: 'SnapshotsGraph: file diffs of a checkpoint (MT-13, HOOKS-2)'
+---
+## What
+**Blocked outside this repo:** HOOKS-2 (diff of a file at a checkpoint, FoundationModelsHooks, status agreed, not built). No session owns it yet. Start only when HOOKS-2 is on Hooks `main`.
+
+MT-13 says `checkpoint(index)` gives "the diff of each of its files". In `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Snapshots/SnapshotsGraph.swift`:
+- `Checkpoint.changes: [FileChange!]!`, where `FileChange { path: String!, diff: String! }`. It is resolved lazily, so `checkpoints` lists don't compute diffs unless the field is selected.
+- Map the HOOKS-2 errors to `CodedError` codes (`UPPER_SNAKE`, EXTRAS-9 rule 8).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `checkpoint(sessionId:, index:) { changes { path diff } }` gives a unified diff per file the checkpoint changed
+- [ ] A `checkpoints` query that does not select `changes` does not call the HOOKS-2 diff API
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Add cases to `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SnapshotsGraphTests.swift` with a real store: one edit gives the expected diff text; laziness checked with a counting store seam or by timing
+- [ ] Update the SDL golden; `swift test --filter Snapshots` passes
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #graphql #snapshots #blocked-external
\ No newline at end of file
